title: Space Drums experiment-log record
description: One record per experiment run. Defined in Phase 00 (Task 00.5, docs/reproducibility-policy.md); written by the Phase 09 harness and every training/evaluation script in Phases 09-19. All fields marked required must be present for a run to be citable in any document.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Bump on any breaking change; keep old records readable.

run_id.description: YYYYMMDD-HHMM-<slug> (local time of start, docs/repo-layout.md naming rules). Unique within experiments/.

phase.description: Two-digit phase number that produced this run, e.g. "09".

task.description: Task id within the phase, e.g. "09.4".

status.description: Only COMPLETED runs may be cited.

description.description: Free-text purpose of the run (one or two sentences).

arm.description: Baseline / system arm per phases/README.md section 9; NA for runs that are not arm-specific (e.g. feature extraction).

config_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonicalised (sorted-key, UTF-8, no-whitespace JSON) fully-resolved config used by the run.

config_path.description: Path (relative to the run directory) of the stored resolved config snapshot, e.g. "config.resolved.yaml".

dataset_version.description: Dataset version identifier, e.g. "ds-v1.0" or "ds-raw-v1.0". Use "ds-none-v0.0" only for runs that consume no dataset (must be justified in description).

dataset_hash.description: SHA-256 of the dataset manifest file for dataset_version.

split.description: Participant-level split actually used (ids are pseudonymous participant codes).

git_sha.description: Full commit hash of the code that ran.

git_dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes. Dirty runs may not be cited as VALIDATED.

hardware_id.description: Identifier of a hardware descriptor in docs/hardware-inventory.md (e.g. "HW-01").

hardware.description: Snapshot of the descriptor at run time (cpu_model, physical_cores, logical_cores, ram_gb, os_build, camera_model, audio_device). Redundant with hardware_id on purpose: records must stay readable if the inventory changes.

environment.description: Runtime environment: interpreter and hash of requirements.lock, plus optional per-library versions and thread settings.

seed.description: Global seed applied to Python, NumPy, PyTorch and GBDT (docs/reproducibility-policy.md section 2).

deterministic.description: True if deterministic algorithms were requested (torch.use_deterministic_algorithms etc.).

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 with timezone offset; null while status is RUNNING.

metrics.description: Flat or nested numeric results. Every key must be a metric named in phases/README.md section 10 or defined in the run's phase document. No metric here is a result until the run is cited by a gate record.

artefacts.description: Files produced by the run (models, plots, tables), each with a hash.

parent_run_id.description: run_id of the run this one reproduces or continues (used for VALIDATED reproduction pairs).
